query_only.sql:
WITH ef AS (
  SELECT f.month, f.value
  FROM fact_dre f
  JOIN dim_unit u ON f.unit_id = u.unit_id
  JOIN dim_account a ON f.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE u.unit = 'Export' AND a.account = 'Freight'
),
r AS (
  SELECT month, value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY month) AS rn,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY month DESC) AS rrd
  FROM ef
)
SELECT
  (AVG(CASE WHEN rrd <= 4 THEN value END)
   - AVG(CASE WHEN rn  <= 8 THEN value END))
  / ABS(AVG(CASE WHEN rn <= 8 THEN value END)) * 100
FROM r
